desc: Number the Markdown headings in lines. A heading line is 1 to 3 "#" characters at the very start, then a single space, then a non-empty title (everything after that space, taken as is). Every other line is ignored, including "#NoSpace", "#### Four" (4 or more "#") and "# " (empty title). Keep counters for levels 1, 2 and 3, all starting at 0. For a heading of level L, add 1 to counter L and reset the counters of all deeper levels to 0; then output the counters of levels 1 through L joined by ".", a space, and the title. For example, a level-3 heading right after the first level-1 heading is numbered "1.0.1". Return the outputs in order.
